caption:
You want to understand power? Start with the Rothschild name.

Not headlines. Not influencers.
Real, generational financial power.

This story didn’t start with Epstein!
It goes back centuries—banking systems, global influence, and elite circles that don’t disappear… they evolve.

Different names. Same level of protection.

So when you ask why no one’s been held accountable—
you’re looking at the surface, not the system!
video_overlay_text_observed: Kinetic word-by-word captions over a talking-head 'deep dive' (e.g. 'YOU KNOW THE MOST', highlighted keywords). No standalone cover card.
audio_content_summary: A ~3-minute spoken 'deep dive' walking a single historical spine: Rothschild banking expands into the US in the 1800s; an 1895 rescue of the US Treasury; a 1907/Jekyll Island meeting that becomes the 1913 Federal Reserve; Robert Maxwell (Ghislaine's father) dies in 1991; his daughter and Jeffrey Epstein enter elite circles; Epstein is said to 'represent the Rothschilds' per the Epstein files, with Les Wexner corroborating; authorities recently searched a Rothschild property; and a closing claim that AG Pam Bondi 'wouldn't look at the survivors' because she is 'part of all of this.'
implied_frame: Frames a continuous two-century lineage in which the same protected financial families ('America is owned by one family') run the government and shield each other, with Epstein as the modern node and current officials complicit. Documented kernels: the 1895 Morgan-Belmont (Rothschild-agent) Treasury rescue; the 1910 Jekyll Island meeting behind the 1913 Fed; the March 2026 French search of Edmond de Rothschild over an ex-staffer's Epstein ties; Epstein's own 'I represent the Rothschilds' email. Disputed/unsupported: that the Rothschilds 'own America,' the Maxwell-death foul-play insinuation, that Epstein literally represented 'all of them,' the Swiss-bank-tax-evasion attribution, and the Bondi-is-complicit claim. The Powerball aside has no primary trace.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~28.4 MB); delivery ~29.0 MB webm, 171s.
